scope.included: All city-status entities in the currently linked official MHOBT workbook; national capital, region/republic-subordinate cities, district/city-subordinate cities.
scope.excluded: Urban settlements (shaharcha), villages, districts as independent cities, planned settlements without city status, advertising inventory.
scope.legal_currentness_caveat: Workbook linked on the official classification page at retrieval. Filename contains 2022 but file HTTP Last-Modified is 2025-12-10 and OOXML modified is 2025-12-10T11:16:43Z. SIAT values describe 2026-01-01 and were updated 2026-06-12. Matching totals do not independently prove every name/status is unchanged through retrieval date.
scope.service_coverage_caveat: Administrative geography is not evidence of Muna Media offices, inventory, supplier agreements or actual service delivery.

sources.role: Live official discovery page linking workbook; MHOBT approval order 59 dated 2020-07-22.
Names, hierarchy, identifiers, region centers. Sheet SOATO, 3310 rows.
Independent country, region, district/city aggregate count validation; not a city-name roster.
Doorway abuse, scaled content abuse and keyword stuffing guardrails.

verification.method: Parse OOXML using Python stdlib; select actual child entities of classifier city groups and capital 1726; deduplicate by exact SOATO string; compare national, 14 region and every available 7-digit district/city aggregate with SIAT 2026 values.

indexation_policy.coverage_selector: All roster cities can be offered as geographic request choices. Persist exact SOATO id and selected city into the inquiry. Do not imply availability; publish verified service status separately.
indexable_page_requirements: Verified service delivery scope and responsible owner for that city.
Substantive city-specific answer or useful planning artifact backed by first-party observations, dated operator confirmations, or a documented case; different questions alone are insufficient.
No invented office, supplier, availability, price, reach or audience statistic.
Clear city/district boundary, scope and update date.
Human Uzbek editorial review and functional city-preserving inquiry path.
Unique intent and useful internal links; no near-duplicate city-name substitution.
indexation_policy.noneligible_handling: Prefer selector state on a useful country/region hub rather than creating thin standalone routes. If separate request/filter URLs are necessary, keep them out of XML sitemaps and noindex while allowing crawlers to read that directive. Noindex is not permission to create misleading doorway content.
indexation_policy.schema_guardrail: No fabricated LocalBusiness address or branch. Administrative roster alone does not justify Service.areaServed; only publish actual verified service area.

uncertainties: No advertising inventory, local office, pricing, audience measurement, demand or fulfillment data was supplied or verified.

Display normalization changes apostrophe glyphs only. Original names and identifiers are preserved. Source spellings including Marxamat, Shaxrixon, Xaqqulobod and Pskent are not silently corrected; approve display aliases separately.

The official SIAT count table lists aggregate districts and administratively subordinate cities, not every city name. Angren aggregate includes Yangiobod, so counting only rows ending in shahri is incomplete.
Old 2014 PDF and 2020 workbook found in search are not used to establish the roster; use the workbook currently linked from the official classifier page.

planning_questions_uz: Toshkentda mijoz qaysi tuman yoki savdo nuqtasiga borishi kerak? Reklama manzili shu yo'nalishga mosmi?
Bir nechta filial bo'lsa, har biriga alohida murojaat havolasi va yo'l ko'rsatmasini beramizmi?
Shahar ichidagi joylashuvlarni bir-biri bilan qanday solishtiramiz: ko'rinish, qatnov yo'nalishi va murojaat manbasi bo'yichami?
launch_centers.proposed_useful_deliverable_uz: Filiallar xaritasi va har bir filial uchun murojaatni ajratish jadvali.
launch_centers.evidence_note: Administrative names and distinct city/district identities from MHOBT; questions and workflow recommendations are editorial proposals, not measured local market facts.
